title: Knife block: two knives won't go in

events.text: The chef's knife 20 cm and bread knife 20 cm don't go in: the chef's knife 20 cm stops 178 mm out, the bread knife 20 cm stops 180 mm out.
The two big knives won't go into the block. They sit on top of their slots and fall over.

I found the cause and fixed it. The chef's and bread knives now go all the way into their slots.

**Cause:** Those two knives collided as one convex hull around the whole knife, about 21 mm thick. Their slots are only 4.5 mm and 3.6 mm wide, so the hull sat on top of the slot and the knife fell over. The other four knives collide as separate blade, bolster and handle pieces, which is why they went in.

**Change:** I set both knives to collide as separate parts, like the others. I didn't change any mass or size.

**Probe results:**
- **Seat:** All six knives seat fully. The chef's and bread knives show -0.3 mm out of slot, rotating 0.0°, the same as the others.
- **Rest:** The knives stay seated with under 0.5 mm of shift.

Please try inserting the chef's and bread knives again, and give the block a lean or a shake to check they stay put.
All 6 knives drop into their slots and go all the way in.
Each knife comes out with a pull of 1.3 to 1.4 times its weight; the block stays put.
On a table tilting toward its back, the set holds to 10° and tips over at 15°.
The contributor approved the object: Looks and feels like the real one now.
